instruction: Use `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.blend`. Keep mesh object `Face`, armature object `Rig`, bone `ctrl_jaw`, and shape key `smile`. Add a driver to `Face.data.shape_keys.key_blocks['smile'].value` and save as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.blend`. The driver's first variable must target `Rig` \ `ctrl_jaw` with `transform_type = 'ROT_X'`. The expression must contain clamp logic and a factor of 2 applied to the driver variable. When `Rig.pose.bones['ctrl_jaw'].rotation_euler.x` is set to `0.5`, `0.1`, and `-0.3`, the evaluated `smile` value must be `1.0`, `0.2`, and `0.0` respectively, within `1e-3`.
source: Blender Manual — Shape Keys and Drivers
